items.title: Xcel Energy (XEL) Stock Looks Fully Priced As Dividend Growth Holds
items.summary: Xcel Energy has delivered a 41.5% gain over the past three years, a solid showing for a regulated utility stock. That performance puts fresh focus on what investors are really paying for today. The central question now is whether the current share price around US$74 is adequately supported by the dividend stream that Xcel Energy is expected to deliver over time. items.title: Xcel Energy Stock: Is XEL Outperforming the Utility Sector?
items.summary: As Xcel Energy has outpaced the utility sector over the past year, Wall Street analysts remain bullish about the stock’s prospects.

items.title: AI Data Centers Need Enormous Amounts of Power: These 5 Dividend Stocks Provide It
items.summary: Data centers are doubling their power demands almost overnight, and regulated utilities that lock in long-term supply contracts stand to collect that revenue for decades. Five names are positioned at the center of this shift, but each carries a different risk that could make or break your income stream.

items.title: Is Xcel Energy a Dividend Stock Retirees Can Actually Count On?
items.summary: Xcel Energy hands retirees a quarterly check that has grown every single year, but wildfire lawsuits, a $60 billion spending plan, and a 10-Year Treasury above 4% raise fair questions about whether that streak holds.

items.title: Can XEL's Strategic Capital Investments Drive Long-Term Growth?
items.summary: Xcel Energy's $70B-plus 2026-2030 investment plan targets 11% rate-base CAGR and 6-8% annual earnings growth through 2030.

items.title: These 3 AI stocks are bought by both hedge funds and mutual funds
items.summary: Investing.com -- Hedge funds and mutual funds both added shares of Bloom Energy, Flex and Seagate Technology last quarter, Goldman Sachs said, as the two investor groups selectively adjusted their exposure to artificial-intelligence-related equities even as they diverged sharply on other AI names.
